brief: Hedge funds de-grossed in 7 of the past 8 sessions through Oct 22, with the pace accelerating. This is the first such streak since April 2026, and it did not occur in 2025. Oct 22 was the 5th-largest de-grossing day this year (-1.6 SD), driven entirely by long selling, the largest since September 2025, led by North America, Europe and EM Asia, with China and Hong Kong hit hardest and Taiwan, Korea and Japan selling more moderately. 9 of 11 sectors unwound risk, led by Info Tech (long selling plus short additions, the largest Info Tech selling since September 2024, with Semi and Semi Eqps most de-grossed, driven by Fundamental L/S, multis and quants) and Industrials (mainly multi-strat and quant selling, the sector's third-largest de-grossing day this year). The Global AI basket (GSXGGLAI) saw its largest selling since end of July, with allocations back to July's lows. Prime book gross leverage fell to the 79th percentile over 1 year at 312.3%, and net leverage fell to the 3rd percentile at 71.8%. This followed a rare run since Oct 15, an AI-led selloff, of momentum and crowded-long factor unwinds in which, on Oct 22, all three major hedge fund strategies fell over 1% the same day for the first time since COVID, with Fundamental L/S losses concentrated in China and Info Tech exposure amid a squeeze in concentrated shorts.
